00253.schedule: 20mg orally once daily continuously. No planned week off. Missed/vomited dose is not replaced (p1).

baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile (NCCP p2).
ECG when clinically indicated (NCCP p2). For QT-risk patients, ECG and electrolytes before treatment; current manufacturer SmPC §4.4.
Review VTE history, medicines, pregnancy possibility and non-hormonal contraception.
regular: Liver profile, INR, ophthalmology and ECG when clinically indicated (NCCP p2).
For QT-risk patients, repeat ECG after at least 4 weeks (steady state), then according to symptoms, medicines and electrolyte changes (manufacturer SmPC §4.4).
Annual gynaecological examination recommended by NCCP p3; investigate new abnormal vaginal bleeding promptly. This is not a routine endometrial ultrasound or biopsy programme.
monitoring.disease: Adjuvant: NCCP requires no routine disease-monitoring tests; continue standard breast follow-up, not generic three-monthly CT or tumour-marker surveillance. Advanced disease: scans according to the consultant response-assessment plan (NCCP p2).
monitoring.bone: Consider menopausal status and individual bone risk. Tamoxifen is not an aromatase inhibitor; no universal drug-specific DXA interval is mandated by NCCP00253.
monitoring.gynaecology_clarification: ACOG CO601 advises against routine endometrial surveillance in asymptomatic patients unless identified as high risk; symptom investigation remains essential.

specific_symptoms: Hot flushes, sleep disruption and vaginal symptoms
Prompt evaluation for abnormal vaginal bleeding
consent: Expected benefit depends on adjuvant versus advanced setting, ER status and individual risk.
Discuss clot risk, uterine changes, visual symptoms, hot flushes and sexual symptoms.
Use non-hormonal contraception during treatment and for 9 months after stopping; absent periods do not prove infertility (manufacturer SmPC §4.6).
00253.surgery_radiotherapy_relationship: The sequence of surgery, chemotherapy and radiotherapy is individual. Do not impose a universal 6-week tamoxifen interruption around breast-cancer surgery. Coordinate radiotherapy overlap with the treating team.

00361.schedule: First 28-day cycle: days 1 and 15. Thereafter day 1 every 28 days (NCCP p1). Each 500 mg administration is two 250 mg/5 mL gluteal injections, taking 1–2 minutes per injection. No IV line, port or pump is used.

baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile (NCCP p2).
Confirm indication/menopausal status, pregnancy exclusion, liver category and IM bleeding risk.
regular: Liver profile when clinically indicated (NCCP p2).
At injections, review tolerability, bruising/bleeding and injection-site nerve symptoms. No NCCP-mandated generic pre-dose ANC or platelet threshold.
monitoring.disease: Response imaging and other tests follow the consultant treatment plan. NCCP does not prescribe a fixed CT or tumour-marker interval.
monitoring.not_routine: No universal ECG, echocardiogram or repeated full blood count schedule is specified for fulvestrant monotherapy. Do not copy CDK4/6 combination monitoring onto this card.
monitoring.bone: Potential osteoporosis risk is described in the SmPC; assess individual fracture risk and bone-health plan. No fixed drug-specific DXA interval is mandated here.

specific_symptoms: Injection soreness, bruising and radiating leg pain
Liver concerns and bleeding risk with IM injections
consent: Confirm the advanced, ER-positive, post-menopausal indication.
Explain injection-site nerve injury and bleeding precautions.
Pregnancy and breastfeeding are excluded. Effective contraception during therapy and for 2 years after the last dose if relevant (EMA SmPC §4.6).
00361.surgery_radiotherapy_relationship: Advanced endocrine control: radiotherapy for symptom relief or local control follows an individual plan. Do not automatically attach a curative surgery/adjuvant sequence.

source_discrepancies.supplemental_source: EMA Faslodex SmPC §4.2 recommends no dose adjustment for mild/moderate hepatic impairment, with caution. Display NCCP dose and make discrepancy explicit for Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation.
EMA describes intervals of one month plus extra dose2weeks afterinitial; patient graphics use exact NCCP q28 schedule.

source_discrepancies.nccp: Both indication lines refer to prior adjuvant anti-oestrogen treatment.
source_discrepancies.supplemental_source: EMA includes endocrine-naive monotherapy and progression on anti-oestrogen therapy; card does not silently expand NCCP mapping.
